about: How build_register.py reads the council's scoring method where the Risk Management Strategy contradicts itself. Every discrepancy in history.json must appear here, either under choices or under not_scoring; the builder fails otherwise. The auditor may change a 'use' value; the risk-assessor agent must not edit this file.

rated_level.why: Ratings use the Actual (current) level: the spend indicators show how controls operate now, with mitigation already in place.

choices.topic: Score at which a risk goes on the Corporate Risk Register

options.table4: Table 4: the Extreme band (15-25) is added to the Corporate Risk Register
options.figure4: Figure 4: risks that score 9 or above go on the Corporate Risk Register

choices.rationale: Table 4 and para 6.3 both tie corporate escalation to Extreme (Red) risks; Figure 4 is the only source of the lower figure.

choices.topic: Name of the band for scores 8-12

options.table4: Table 4 band name (Medium - High), which carries the RAG colour, escalation and response

choices.rationale: The register reports the RAG colour, escalation and response, which only Table 4 gives; the Figure 1 name is shown next to it.

choices.topic: Number of the Medium impact level
choices.rationale: Table 1 and the Figure 1 matrix both number Medium 3; para 4.3 would leave no level 3.

options.gbp: The £ figures, which do not overlap (Medium £175k-£500k, Major £500k-£2M)
options.percent: The % of budget figures, where Medium 0.1%-0.3% and Major 0.25%-1% overlap

choices.rationale: Only the £ figures give a single band for every amount; a financial exposure is checked against them.

choices.topic: Where an Extreme risk is escalated

options.table4: Table 4: add to the Corporate Risk Register
options.para6.3: Para 6.3: escalate to the Executive Director, to consider the Directorate or the Corporate register

choices.rationale: Follows CH-1, which reads escalation from Table 4.

not_scoring.DIS-05: Version of the appetite guidance cited; does not change a score, band or appetite level.
not_scoring.DIS-06: Name of the committee; does not change scoring.
not_scoring.DIS-07: Names of the evaluation levels only; the register rates the Actual/Current level (rated_level).
not_scoring.DIS-09: Cross-reference to the policy appendix; does not change scoring.
not_scoring.DIS-10: Cross-reference to the definitions appendix; does not change scoring.
